title: Goblins and Gunslingers
description:
Magic. Gunpowder. Your next hand.The town's gone lawless. Your deck is the law. Goblins & Gunslingers is a free-to-play western-fantasy card duel where spells, six-shooters, and unlikely allies share the same dusty table.

Make every lane countFight across a seven-lane battlefield: five positions on Main Street and two high-rise slots. Take cover, set up a crossfire, and choose which threat to answer first. Placement can turn a modest creature into the start of a winning play.

Spend Mana to play cards and bank Gold for Deputies and items. Unspent Gold carries between turns, with one base Gold added on each of your turns. Spend now, or save for the muscle that can swing the showdown.

Build your kind of troubleExplore 250+ cards across eight factions: Humans, Goblins, Desert Devils, Straw Elves, Gnomes, Dwarves, Golems, and Beasts. Combine two factions, hire a Deputy, and find the synergies that make your outfit dangerous.

Turn charged Gnomes into towering Golems. Set off a ricochet, spring a trap, or squeeze one last play from a creature's Last Stand. The right hand gives you options; the right timing makes them count.

Choose your showdown• Story Tutorial — Learn the rules as you find your footing on the frontier.

• Practice Duels — Test a new deck and sharpen your reads against the computer.

• Online Multiplayer — Take your outfit to the table against other players.

• Frontier Run — Face a roguelike gauntlet and earn upgrades between fights.
Earn your next packCompleted online matches award 50 Ore for a win and 25 Ore for a loss. Exchange 100 Ore for a booster pack and keep building your collection. Ore can also be purchased through Steam checkout.

Pull up a chair. Deal 'em.
description_short: Deal spells and six-shooters across a seven-lane frontier. Goblins & Gunslingers is a western-fantasy card duel where gunpowder meets magic — draft 8 outlaw factions, hire deputies, flip Gnomes into Golems, and outdraw rivals in ranked play or a roguelike Frontier Run.
